import random, subprocess, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp/t')
import image as img
from stress_native import random_layout, run, h
rng=random.Random(29)
for it in range(60):
    R=rng.randrange(1,65)
    vals=sorted({rng.randrange(1,1<<rng.choice([10,40,70,128])) for _ in range(R-1)}) if R>1 else []
    starts=[0]+vals
    while len(starts)<R:
        x=starts[-1]+rng.randrange(1,1<<40)
        if x>=(1<<128): break
        starts.append(x)
    R=len(starts)
    hops=[rng.choice([None]+list(range(0,1000))) for _ in range(R)]
    layout=random_layout(R,starts,rng)
    A=0
    pyimg=img.build(R,starts,hops,layout)
    lines=['PACK %d %d %d'%(R,len(layout),A)]
    lines+= ['%s %d'%(h(starts[i]), -1 if hops[i] is None else hops[i]) for i in range(R)]
    for kind,mode,cached,lo,span,kids in layout:
        lines.append('%d %d %d %d %d %s'%(lo,span,mode,cached,len(kids),' '.join(str(k) for k in kids)))
    out=run(lines)
    if out[0]!=pyimg.hex:
        print('mismatch it',it,'R',R,'N',len(layout))
        a=bytes.fromhex(out[0]); b=bytes.fromhex(pyimg.hex)
        for i in range(len(a)):
            if a[i]!=b[i]:
                print('first diff byte',i, a[i], b[i])
                # which node?
                off=64
                for idx,(kind,mode,cached,lo,span,kids) in enumerate(layout):
                    used = 32+span*img.WIDTH[mode] if kind else 32+4*len(kids)+(len(kids)-1)*img.WIDTH[mode]
                    alloc=(used+63)//64*64
                    if off<=i<off+alloc:
                        print('node',idx,'kind',kind,'mode',mode,'lo',lo,'span',span,'kids',kids,'off',off,'alloc',alloc,'rel',i-off)
                        print('  starts[lo:lo+span]', [hex(x) for x in starts[lo:lo+span]])
                        print('  spread', hex(starts[lo+span-1]-starts[lo]))
                        break
                    off+=alloc
                break
        print('layout:',layout[:12])
        break
PYEOF
